instruction: Configure Thunderbird to automatically forward all incoming emails from anonym-x2024@outlook.com to backup-email@protonmail.com. Only configure locally in Thunderbird, don't modify the online account.

metadata.explanation: Variation with different forward target email (backup-email@protonmail.com instead of anonym-x2024@gmail.com). Evaluator verifies filter is enabled, action is Forward, target is backup-email@protonmail.com, and condition is ALL (no filtering). Same complexity as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL SEMANTIC ERROR: Instruction requires forwarding emails specifically FROM anonym-x2024@outlook.com, but evaluator checks for condition 'ALL' which applies to ALL incoming emails regardless of sender
Expected condition should filter by sender address (e.g., 'AND (from,contains,anonym-x2024@outlook.com)'), not 'ALL'
The evaluator will incorrectly pass if user creates a filter that forwards all emails to the target, even without filtering by the required sender
This is a fundamental mismatch between instruction requirements (sender-specific filter) and verification logic (all-emails filter)
Correct aspects: Checks enabled=yes, action=Forward, actionValue=backup-email@protonmail.com, reads correct filter file, has appropriate postconfig
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change expected condition from ['ALL'] to a sender-based filter condition like ['AND (from,contains,anonym-x2024@outlook.com)']

Alternatively, update the instruction to match the evaluator: 'Configure Thunderbird to automatically forward ALL incoming emails to backup-email@protonmail.com' (removing the sender-specific requirement)
